description: Looks up one IPv4 or IPv6 address against the two authoritative, keyless public sources: RDAP registry data (who holds the block, in which country, since when, abuse contact) via the ARIN-to-RIR referral chain, and the origin ASN from Team Cymru's DNS service. No city-level geolocation and no VPN/proxy detection — those need a licensed commercial database this endpoint deliberately does not use. Built for going through a list of IPs one at a time. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.
